paite: Huan, amah huai laltutphah tunga tupa khut taklam ah laibu a sunglam leh a polama kigelh chiamtehna sagiha chiamteh ka mutaa.
english: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

paite: Huan angel hat khatin aw ngaihtaka, Kua ahia laibu tuh honga, huai achiamteha phel tham? chia genkhai ka muta a.
english: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”

paite: Huan vantung hiin, leitung hiam, a hihkeileh lei nuaiah leng huai laibu hong thei hiam, ahihkeileh a tung en thei kuamah a om kei a.
english: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book, or to look in it.

paite: Huan huai laibu hongtham hiam, a hihkeileh huai a tung en tham, kuamah a om louh jiakin kei tuh ka kap kapa:
english: And I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book, or to look in it.

paite: Huan upate laka khatin ka kiangah, Kap ken, ngai in, himpinelkai, Juda nam a, David Zungin, laibu th hong thei ding leh huai achiamtehna sagihte leng phel thei dingin a vual zouta, a chi a.
english: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome; he who opens the book and its seven seals.”

paite: Huan, huai laltutphah leh huai gan hing lite leh huai upate lai ah thahsa hileh kilawm, Belamnou, ki sagih leh mit sagih nei, ding ka mu a, huan huai mit sagihte tuh Pathian kha agih, leitung tengtenga sawlkhiakte ahi uhi.
english: I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns, and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

paite: Huan, amah a hongpaia, huan laltutphah tunga tupa khut takalama kipan laibu tuh a la a.
english: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

paite: Huan huai laibu a lak takin, gan hing lite leh upa sawmnih leh lite, gosem khat chiat leh dangkaeng belhbute gim namtuia dim chiat tawiin, Belamnou maah a khupboh ua, huai gim namtiu tuh misiangthoute thumna ahi.
english: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

paite: Huan la thak khat a sa ua, Laibu tuh la a, huaia achiamtehna te phel tham na hi: thahin na omta a, chi chih leh pau chih leh mi chih leh nam chiha mite Pathian adinga na sisana na leitak jiakin.
english: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book, and to open its seals: for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood, out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,

paite: Huan ka Pathiankiang uah amau lalgam leh siampute hi dingin na bawla; huan amau tuh leitung ah vai a hawm ding uhi, chiin
english: and made us kings and priests to our God, and we will reign on earth.”

paite: Huan ka et leh, huan laltutphah leh, gan hingte lah upate kimvel ah, angel tampi aw ka zata a; huan a tam dan uh sang sawm mun sang sawm leh a sanga sang tampi ahi ua;
english: I saw, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders; and the number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands;

paite: thaha om, Belamnou-in hatna khawng, hauhsakna khawng, thilhihtheihna khawng zahtakhuaina khawng, thupina khawng, vualjawlna khawng mu tham ahi, chiin nakpiin a kikou ua.
english: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

paite: Huan thil siam khempeuh, vana om leh leitunga om leh lei nuaia om leh tuipi tunga om leh amaua thil omte tengtengin, laltutphah tunga tupa kiangah leh, Belamnou kiangah, vualjawlna leh zahtakhuaina leh thupina leh vaihawmna, khantawn khantawnin om hen, a chih uh ka ja a.Huan ganging liten, Amen, a chi ua. Huan upate tuh a khupboh ua, a beta uhi.
english: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen! TR omits “Amen!” ”

paite: Huan ganging liten, Amen, a chi ua. Huan upate tuh a khupboh ua, a beta uhi.
english: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” The TR adds “twenty-four” elders fell down and worshiped. TR adds “the one living forever and ever”
